vocabulary_rule: A learning word is defined in plain language only after the child sees or performs its bounded distinction.
layout_rule: Words sit in reserved illustration space or on dedicated paper-activity pages; the book contains no game menus, dashboards or digital controls.
paper_activity_rule: Activities use pointing, tracing, speaking, page turns or separate safe paper only.
repeated_object_rule: Repeated learning objects use the same versioned OpenMoji asset. The four lantern quarters are mechanical crops of that same stable emoji, never generated story assets.
returning_character_rule: Mia, Sol and Tavi are permanent. Pax is the single E02 guest and never supplies an answer before an attempt.
excluded_foundational_inputs: negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantities
